svg.text: Concept 1: the clip protocol changes what evidence is visible
Real MB140 example: BBP12 validation frames sampled every 5 s. Phase labels shown here are annotations, not inference inputs.
The 8-frame clip ends at the prediction timestamp. Here the target would be t = 3474 s, RSD = 3010 s.
visual frames are all at or before t
The same 8 sampled frames can be centered on t = 3459 s, RSD = 3025 s; three later frames are then visible.
post-target frames are inside the clip
BBP12 annotations near t: Omentum division -> Gastro-jejunal anastomosis
